title: Mercury Planet Ka Khaufnaak Weather! 🪐 #shorts
idea: Mercury experiences extreme surface temperatures ranging from -173 °C at night to 427 °C during the day due to a lack of heat-trapping atmosphere.

lines.text: Mercury planet par ek hi din mein blasting fire aur freezing cold hota hai!
Din mein yahan ka temperature 427 °C tak khaufnaak garam hota hai!
Lekin raat hote hi temperature -173 °C tak drop ho jaata hai!
Iska core poore volume ka 57% hai jabki Prithvi ka sirf 17%!
Atmosphere na hone se yahan extreme surface temperature swing milta hai!
Kya aap aise dangerous planet par ek din bhi bita sakte ho?

Kya aap jaante ho Mercury par din mein 427 °C garmi aur raat mein -173 °C thand hoti hai? Jaaniye Solar System ke iss sabse extreme planet ke bare mein! 🚀

facts.claim: Mercury surface temperature ranges from -173 °C to 427 °C
Mercury's core occupies about 57% of its volume while Earth's is 17%
